# Create API key
{: .no_toc }

Create a key with least-privilege permissions.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `KEY-02` |
| **Route** | `/dev/keys/new` · deep link `substratal://dev/keys/new` |
| **Where** | Developer › API Keys |
| **Who can use it** | api_keys.manage or app owner (app-scoped) |
| **Kind** | form |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwDialog` with `AdwPreferencesGroup` |
